skill.summary: Use when building a weighted gene co-expression network from a bulk expression matrix and a sample group file, filtering variable genes by MAD, identifying co-expression modules with WGCNA, correlating modules with traits, and exporting module-level plots and gene tables. NOT for single-cell RNA-seq, differential expression testing, methylation analysis, or datasets that are too small for WGCNA after quality control.
